problem_or_gap: Queued exact-source runtime probes become promotion-stale when later semantic generations land. Whole-repository SHA equality is conservative but over-invalidates unrelated churn. Reusing CI path filters is unsafe: E3 reproduced that the WP206 G5 workflow omits five direct production imports of persistent_agency_kernel.py. F2 needs a narrower currentness proof that is content-bound and explicitly fails closed when dependency-closure completeness is unknown.

proposed_delta.name: RuntimeSubjectBoundaryFingerprint
proposed_delta.implementation_shape: small deterministic F2-native Python helper; no Bazel/Nix/OpenTelemetry runtime dependency
envelope_fields: runtime/toolchain identity where behavior depends on it
proposed_delta.initial_closure_strategy: For the bounded Python F2 target, recursively parse local import statements from declared entry modules under src/frankenstein2 and src/state, resolve only repository-local modules, add explicit non-code materials/config/harness inputs, and return UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE on unresolved local import, dynamic import/load indicator, missing file, path escape, ambiguous module, or unsupported dependency mechanism. Do not claim general Python dependency completeness beyond the supported subset.
proposed_delta.promotion_rule: Only VERIFIED_COMPLETE + equal recomputed boundary digest may support a narrow RUNTIME_SUBJECT_INVARIANT receipt across an unrelated newer repository commit. UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE falls back to historical-only/no current-generation promotion. Equality never raises the observed runtime tier and never mints whole-system acceptance.
proposed_delta.provenance_rule: Keep exact subject commit/artifact/runtime identity permanently even when a narrower closure comparison establishes invariance relative to a newer generation.

counterhypotheses: Whole-repository SHA-only invalidation is operationally simpler and may be preferable if actual unrelated-churn replay debt is negligible.
A static Python import walker can miss dynamic/config/generated dependencies; therefore any unsupported dependency mechanism must produce UNKNOWN rather than VERIFIED_COMPLETE.
The runtime probe scheduler may gain little if queue latency is reduced enough that promotion staleness rarely occurs; measure before broadening rollout.
A full hermetic build/action graph system could provide stronger closure guarantees, but importing that machinery would likely exceed the marginal value of this narrow F2 feature.
evidence_refs: Bazel official Remote Caching and Hermeticity documentation: declared action inputs and hermetic source/tool identity pattern
SLSA v1.2 Build Provenance: build definition, resolved dependencies and artifact subject separation
OpenTelemetry resource semantic conventions: service.version as exact observed artifact/version identity only
upstream_claims_reproduced: WP206 dedicated workflow path list is not a complete semantic dependency closure: five direct persistent_agency_kernel.py local production imports are omitted
Content/provenance identity answers WHAT EXECUTED but not WHETHER AN OLDER SUBJECT REMAINS CURRENT after successor changes
Verified dependency-closure equality can remove unrelated-churn false staleness in the bounded synthetic ablation without accepting omitted relevant changes
upstream_claims_not_reproduced: No claim that F2 currently has a complete transitive dependency closure
No claim that RuntimeSubjectBoundaryFingerprint reduces real target-runtime latency yet
No claim that equal closure fingerprint proves behavioral equivalence beyond the declared supported boundary
No runtime, GRID10, GWT, J-Space, effect, completion, training or whole-system acceptance claim
baseline_definition: Current conservative runtime-subject promotion law in workpackages/RUNTIME_CREDIT_CONVERGENCE_DIRECTIVE.md: historical runtime plus newer repository CI cannot be composed into current-generation runtime credit without explicit semantic invariance; current implementation has no machine-bound verified closure proof for that invariance branch.
required_tests: Canonical serialization/digest determinism across path ordering.
Exact subject_commit_sha remains in receipt even when boundary equality is established against a newer commit.
Recursive direct+transitive supported local imports are included.

WP206 regression: closure must include agency_state.py, goal_lifecycle.py, persistent_pulse.py, state_fingerprint.py, wake_hold.py and unifieddb_identity.py when persistent_agency_kernel.py is an entry module.
Unrelated repository file mutation leaves verified boundary digest unchanged.
Any bound direct or transitive dependency mutation changes digest.
Dynamic import/load indicator returns UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE unless dependency is explicitly materialized and the supported verifier can prove closure.
Equal digest never increments runtime tier or whole-system acceptance.
required_ablations: Repeat E4 cases against the actual implemented helper: unchanged, unrelated change, listed relevant change, previously omitted dependency change.
Disable recursive import discovery and confirm the previously omitted WP206 dependency mutation becomes a caught negative control, demonstrating why naive path lists are insufficient.
Inject one dynamic import indicator and verify UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE fallback.
Compare conservative whole-repo mode versus verified-closure mode on the same queued-probe fixture; currentness decisions must differ only for changes proven outside the closure.
required_measurements: fingerprint construction wall time and bytes hashed on the repository-component fixture
number of closure members and unresolved dependency indicators
false-stale and false-current counts on deterministic fixture
queue replay avoided count only after a real queued runtime-probe workflow exists; do not synthesize production benefit
target runtime credit remains zero until an actually executed higher-tier probe is observed at its exact subject
expected_token_delta: approximately zero at runtime; deterministic metadata only
expected_latency_delta: small fingerprinting overhead at bind/reentry; potential reduction in replay/staleness latency is hypothesis until measured
expected_resource_delta: O(verified closure bytes) hashing plus static dependency walk; no model/provider calls
quality_success_metric: Zero false-current decisions in all required negative controls; zero false-stale decisions for explicitly unrelated fixture changes when closure is VERIFIED_COMPLETE; UNKNOWN fallback for unsupported closure cases; no evidence-credit inflation.
rollback_or_reject_rule: Reject or keep whole-repository conservative fallback if the verifier can mark VERIFIED_COMPLETE while a behavior-relevant supported local/config/harness dependency remains outside the digest, if dynamic/unresolved dependencies do not fail closed, if repository-component overhead is disproportionate, or if measured queued-probe replay debt is too small to justify the added complexity.
known_failure_modes: generated files not represented in manifest
config or schema files read indirectly
native extension behavior outside supported Python closure
mistaking service.version/artifact provenance for successor semantic equivalence
mistaking closure equality for higher runtime-tier acceptance
